request.purpose: Check exact-recipe age-pair feasibility and produce descriptive recipe-level contrasts for the frozen SCM trajectory prediction.
request.model_spec: Use supplied pandas DataFrame DF. Recipe key is exact tuple of the seven ingredient columns (exclude Age and target). For duplicate rows sharing recipe and age, use their mean strength solely as a recipe-age summary. SCM share=(Blast Furnace Slag+Fly Ash)/(Cement+Blast Furnace Slag+Fly Ash). Report JSON with n_rows, n_recipes, recipes_repeated_across_ages, rows and distinct recipes per age, plus for each of intervals 1-7, 7-28, 28-56: number recipes with both endpoint ages, zero-SCM and nonzero-SCM recipe counts, mean and median within-recipe gain in each group, and Pearson correlation of recipe SCM share with gain where computable. State missing-pair counts relative to all recipes and explicitly mark sparse/empty comparisons. No inferential p-values. Output only compact valid JSON.
